title: comdirect-fetch: Depot-Performance
description: Zwei Sichten auf die Depot-Performance (KONZEPT.md Abschnitt 6 Phase 4, Issue #12). Oben: unrealisierter Gewinn/Verlust auf Basis des von comdirect gemeldeten Anschaffungswerts (acquisition_value) der aktuell gehaltenen Positionen – deckt die VOLLE Kaufhistorie ab, aber NICHT bereits realisierte Gewinne/Verluste verkaufter Positionen. Unten: um externe Ein-/Auszahlungen bereinigte Kennzahlen (Netto-Kapitaleinsatz-Methode und tagesverkettete Time-Weighted Return) – präziser in der Methodik, aber NUR ab dem Zeitpunkt aussagekräftig, seit dem comdirect-fetch läuft (net_invested_capital ist NULL für Snapshots vor v0.23.0 bzw. ohne erkannte Depot↔Verrechnungskonto-Verknüpfung, siehe docs/konzept.md Abschnitt 6).

panels.title: Depotwert vs. Kapitaleinsatz
panels.description: Summe über alle Depots. Kapitaleinsatz = Anschaffungswert der aktuell gehaltenen Positionen (acquisition_value), keine vollständige Einzahlungshistorie.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ps.recorded_at AS time, 'Depotwert' AS metric, SUM(ps.total_value) AS value
FROM portfolio_snapshots ps
WHERE $__timeFilter(ps.recorded_at)
GROUP BY ps.recorded_at
UNION ALL
SELECT ps.recorded_at AS time, 'Kapitaleinsatz' AS metric, SUM(ps.acquisition_value) AS value
FROM portfolio_snapshots ps
WHERE $__timeFilter(ps.recorded_at)
GROUP BY ps.recorded_at
ORDER BY time

SELECT ps.recorded_at AS time, 'Unrealisierter Gewinn/Verlust' AS metric, SUM(ps.total_value) - SUM(ps.acquisition_value) AS value
FROM portfolio_snapshots ps
WHERE $__timeFilter(ps.recorded_at)
GROUP BY ps.recorded_at
ORDER BY time

SELECT ps.recorded_at AS time, 'Rendite' AS metric,
       (SUM(ps.total_value) - SUM(ps.acquisition_value)) / NULLIF(SUM(ps.acquisition_value), 0) * 100 AS value
FROM portfolio_snapshots ps
WHERE $__timeFilter(ps.recorded_at)
GROUP BY ps.recorded_at
ORDER BY time

SELECT SUM(total_value) - SUM(acquisition_value) AS `Gewinn_Verlust`
FROM portfolio_snapshots
WHERE recorded_at = (SELECT MAX(recorded_at) FROM portfolio_snapshots)

SELECT (SUM(total_value) - SUM(acquisition_value)) / NULLIF(SUM(acquisition_value), 0) * 100 AS `Rendite`
FROM portfolio_snapshots
WHERE recorded_at = (SELECT MAX(recorded_at) FROM portfolio_snapshots)

panels.title: Depotwert vs. Netto-Kapitaleinsatz (bereinigt, seit Tracking-Beginn)
panels.description: Netto-Kapitaleinsatz = Summe aller Wertpapier-Käufe abzüglich -Verkäufe auf den depot-verknüpften Verrechnungskonten (transaction_type 'Securities'), erhaltene Dividenden separat. Nur Snapshots ab v0.23.0 mit erkannter Depot↔Konto-Verknüpfung. Bei nur einem Depot Summe = Einzelwert.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ps.recorded_at AS time, 'Depotwert' AS metric, SUM(ps.total_value) AS value
FROM portfolio_snapshots ps
WHERE $__timeFilter(ps.recorded_at) AND ps.net_invested_capital IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ps.recorded_at
UNION ALL
SELECT ps.recorded_at AS time, 'Netto-Kapitaleinsatz' AS metric, SUM(ps.net_invested_capital) AS value
FROM portfolio_snapshots ps
WHERE $__timeFilter(ps.recorded_at) AND ps.net_invested_capital IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ps.recorded_at
UNION ALL
SELECT ps.recorded_at AS time, 'Dividenden kumuliert' AS metric, SUM(ps.dividends_received) AS value
FROM portfolio_snapshots ps
WHERE $__timeFilter(ps.recorded_at) AND ps.net_invested_capital IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ps.recorded_at
ORDER BY time

SELECT ps.recorded_at AS time, 'Bereinigter Gewinn/Verlust' AS metric,
       SUM(ps.total_value) + SUM(ps.dividends_received) - SUM(ps.net_invested_capital) AS value
FROM portfolio_snapshots ps
WHERE $__timeFilter(ps.recorded_at) AND ps.net_invested_capital IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ps.recorded_at
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Time-Weighted Return (%, tagesverkettet)
panels.description: Präzisere, um den Zeitpunkt der Ein-/Auszahlungen bereinigte Rendite (KONZEPT.md Abschnitt 6). Bei mehreren Depots wird bewusst nicht über die Prozentwerte summiert/gemittelt - aktuell nur für ein einzelnes Depot aussagekräftig.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ps.recorded_at AS time, 'TWR' AS metric, ps.time_weighted_return_pct AS value
FROM portfolio_snapshots ps
WHERE $__timeFilter(ps.recorded_at) AND ps.time_weighted_return_pct IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time

SELECT SUM(total_value) + SUM(dividends_received) - SUM(net_invested_capital) AS `Gewinn_Verlust`
FROM portfolio_snapshots
WHERE recorded_at = (SELECT MAX(recorded_at) FROM portfolio_snapshots WHERE net_invested_capital IS NOT NULL)

SELECT (SUM(total_value) + SUM(dividends_received) - SUM(net_invested_capital)) / NULLIF(SUM(net_invested_capital), 0) * 100 AS `Rendite`
FROM portfolio_snapshots
WHERE recorded_at = (SELECT MAX(recorded_at) FROM portfolio_snapshots WHERE net_invested_capital IS NOT NULL)

SELECT time_weighted_return_pct AS `TWR`
FROM portfolio_snapshots
WHERE time_weighted_return_pct IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY recorded_at DESC
LIMIT 1
